attempt: Ship generated maple foliage with smoothed partial alpha in a Hytale 0.7.2 Cutout model, accepting its blended Blockbench preview as edge-quality evidence.
reason_failed: The user reported black specks and red contours around all leaf colors in Hytale, absent from the desired editor appearance. The atlas had 662741 partial-alpha texels and only 66 opaque texels; the approved foliage atlas was binary alpha. Read-only installed client shader inspection shows ALPHA_TEST discards only alpha equal to zero and albedo uses sampled RGB, allowing faint nonzero-alpha residues to survive cutout rendering.
environment: Hytale release 0.7.2 on Windows; Zytale Buildings and Furnishment 1.12.1; native Blockbench Hytale prop previews
error_signature: Near-invisible alpha residues become black specks and bright red fringes in placed foliage; editor blended preview differs.
conditions: Generated RGBA foliage includes antialiasing and low-alpha contamination
Placed models use the client cutout path
Editor blending conceals faint residual texels
workaround: Normalize export alpha to 0 below 128 and 255 otherwise, using the established approved binary-alpha contract. Preserve RGB byte-for-byte for all retained pixels. Revision 1.12.2 removes 126632 low-alpha texels; 536175 retained RGB pixels are unchanged; models, UVs, definitions and Java classes are byte-identical. M preview and package checks pass and candidate is installed. Final Hytale client visual acceptance is pending.

source_refs.description: Diagnosis, protected appearance, fix and validation limits
Read-only installed client shader; see alpha test and albedo sampling
